title.narrative: Human Rights Mainstreaming in the Implementation of Indonesian Criminal Justice System

description.narrative: The project's expected effects on society are 1) ensure the mainstream of human rights in Indonesia's Criminal Procedure Code and 2) strengthen legislation process, policy, institutions, and public awareness. Outcomes 1: increase awareness among policy makers on the importance of human rights compliance on Criminal Procedure Code. Outcome 2: increased public awareness and youth engagement on the human rights compliance on Criminal Procedure Code. Outputs from outcome 1: a) policy paper on international human rights compliance in Indonesian Criminal Procedure Code; reccomendations for implementing regulations and/or potential law review, b) the policy advocacy on Criminal Procedure Code based on human rights compliance of international standard, providing recommendations and guiding the preparation of implementing regulations and/or potential law review, c) policy paper on Asset Forfeiture in criminal process based on human rights principles. Outputs from outcome 2: a) civil society organizations and youth groups are consolidated and actively engaged in promoting human rights compliance within the Criminal Procedure Code, supporting the preparation of implementing regulations and/or potential review and b) evaluation study on legislation process of Criminal Procedure Code revision based on the standard of civil rights fullfilment. Through this project, the grantee will conduct policy advocacy and develop recommendations for the implementing regulations to influence operational procedures, ensuring the protection and fulfillment of women’s rights.
